en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a large, ornate building identified as 'Allmänna Läroverket' (the Public Grammar School) in Sundsvall, Sweden. The front side includes handwriting along the right edge, while the reverse side shows postage, an address with elegant handwriting, a Swedish postage stamp ('Sverige Fem Öre'), and printed text indicating the postcard format in both Swedish and French.
